note: All 16 string tables and 414 default-mode curve rows decoded. Corrections below are source-backed; not all gameplay capture/stacking semantics are verified. No ARAM/FastPred curves used.

corrections.before: Damaging an Enemy Hero with an ability deals 6% (+0.5% per minute) of the damage as a DoT over 3s.
corrections.after: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

corrections.before: Takedowns grant 2 Ability Haste.
corrections.after: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.

corrections.before: Gain 4% Bonus Damage, increased by 0.6% per 10 Units killed.
corrections.after: Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.

corrections.before: Entering Hero Combat grants 20% Total Attack Speed for 4.5s.
corrections.after: Entering Hero Combat grants 20% Total Attack Speed for 4s.

corrections.before: Basic Attacks heal for 3% of damage dealt (8% for Critical Strikes).
corrections.after: Restore Health equal to 3% of Basic Attack damage dealt, increased to 6% for Critical Strikes.

corrections.before: Deal +8% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on kill.
corrections.after: Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.

corrections.before: After killing 150 units, gain 20% Critical Chance and 5% Critical Damage.
corrections.after: After killing 150 units, permanently gain 20% Critical Chance.

corrections.before: Increase stats gained from Items (not passives/crests) by 12%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.
corrections.after: Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.

corrections.before: Deal 6% bonus damage On-Hit, randomly Physical/Magical/True.
corrections.after: Deal 5% bonus damage On-Hit, randomly Physical, Magical or True.

corrections.before: Gain +10 Health and +1.25 Ability Haste per Level.
corrections.after: Gain 10 Health and 1 Ability Haste per Level.

corrections.before: Convert each 1% Crit Chance into 1 Ability Haste (you lose the crit stat).
corrections.after: Convert each 1% Critical Chance into 0.8 Ability Haste (you lose the converted crit stat).

corrections.before: On cast, gain 6% of the mana cost as permanent Max Mana; +5% MS at 600.
corrections.after: Ability casts grant 5% of their Mana or Energy cost as permanent Max Mana. At 500 bonus Max Mana, gain 5% Movement Speed.

corrections.before: Gain +0.5% Increased Damage and +1% Damage Reduction per item owned.
corrections.after: Gain 0.5% increased Damage and 0.75% Damage Reduction per Item.

corrections.before: Basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher progress 1% faster per 1 Mana Regen.
corrections.after: Basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher progress 0.75% faster per 1 Mana Regen, up to 50%.

corrections.before: On activation, the major also deals 4% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
corrections.after: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.

corrections.before: Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 5% of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
corrections.after: Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 8% of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage, with an 8s cooldown per target.

corrections.before: Damaging a hero with your Ultimate reduces their Physical Armor by 30%.
corrections.after: Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.

corrections.before: Take 8% less damage from AoE Abilities.
corrections.after: Take 7% less damage from AoE Abilities.

corrections.before: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.5% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.4% per level).
corrections.after: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

corrections.before: Casting your Ultimate grants you and nearby allies 20% movement speed and 10 Ultimate Haste. 20s cooldown.
corrections.after: Gain 10 Ultimate Haste. Casting your Ultimate grants you and allies within 1500 units 25% Movement Speed for 4s. 20s cooldown.

corrections.before: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) physical damage On-Hit, +100% for 3s vs heroes.
corrections.after: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

corrections.before: Killing an Enemy Unit restores 1% of your Maximum Health and grants 2 Gold.
corrections.after: Killing an Enemy Unit restores 0.75% of your Maximum Health and grants 2 Gold.

corrections.before: After 8s without hero damage, regen 0.2/0.4/0.8/1.2% Max Health/s (Levels 1/6/11/16).
corrections.after: After 8s without taking Hero damage, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per second at Levels 1/6/11/16.

corrections.before: Enemies hit by your DoT effects receive 45% less healing for 3s.
corrections.after: Your DoT abilities and Immobilizing Effects reduce Enemy Heroes' healing by 45% for 3s.

corrections.before: Camp Leader kills grant 8% Bonus Damage for 20s (2x on Epic Monsters) and 4% Movement Speed.
corrections.after: Camp Leader kills grant 10% Bonus Damage and 4% Movement Speed for 20s, with 100% bonus duration for Epic Monsters.

corrections.before: After taking hero damage, restore 4/5/6/8% of your missing health (Levels 1/6/11/16) over 3s.
corrections.after: After taking Hero damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health at Levels 1/6/11/16 over 8s.

corrections.before: Deal 10% Bonus Damage to Immobilized Targets.
corrections.after: Deal 10% Bonus Damage to Immobilized or Slowed Targets.

corrections.before: Any healing or shielding you receive is increased by 15%.
corrections.after: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.

corrections.before: Basic Attacks vs heroes heal you and nearby allies for 2 (+0.5/lvl)(+6% MP).
corrections.after: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).

corrections.before: Gain 8% Movement Speed when out of combat.
corrections.after: Gain 7% Movement Speed when out of combat.

corrections.before: 25% of ability damage taken is stored and dealt to you as a DoT instead.
corrections.after: 20% of Ability damage taken is dealt to you as a 3s DoT instead.

corrections.before: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1.5% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
corrections.after: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.

corrections.before: Damaging a hero with an ability heals you and nearby allies for 8.
corrections.after: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 8 (+10% Magical Power), once per cast.

corrections.before: Kills grant +4% Damage and +6% Move Speed for 12s (stacks 5x).
corrections.after: Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.

corrections.before: Deal 12% increased damage to heroes, but take 6% increased damage.
corrections.after: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.

corrections.before: Nearby enemy heroes (within 800 units) take 5% increased Magical Damage, and your True Damage against them is increased 12%.
corrections.after: Deal 4% increased Magical Damage and 12% increased True Damage to Enemy Heroes within 800 units.

corrections.before: Gain charges equal to damage dealt to heroes; +0.75% Lifesteal per 100 charges.
corrections.after: Store 100% of Hero damage as charges for 3s. Gain 0.75% Lifesteal per 100 charges.

corrections.before: Deal 10% bonus damage vs heroes with more current health than you.
corrections.after: Deal 1%-8% increased damage as your Health falls from 100% to 20%.

corrections.before: Basic Attacks deal 12% bonus True Damage to targets below 30% Max Health.
corrections.after: Basic Attacks deal 10% bonus True Damage to targets below 40% Max Health.

corrections.before: Hitting a hero with an ability steals 10 (+1% Max Mana) Mana.
corrections.after: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes steal 10 (+1% of the target's Max Mana) Mana.

corrections.before: Minions/Monsters deal 30% less damage to you; Towers 25% less.
corrections.after: Take 35% less damage from Minions and Monsters, and 25% less from Towers.

corrections.before: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times.
corrections.after: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.

corrections.before: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s.
corrections.after: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s. Gain 4% Movement Speed while the shield holds.

corrections.before: Cleanse all crowd control and gain 400 Tenacity when below 25% Maximum Health.
corrections.after: Cleanse all crowd control and gain 400 Tenacity when below 25% Maximum Health. Cleanse has a 20s cooldown.

corrections.before: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you.
corrections.after: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you, triggering On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

corrections.before: Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless (max 6). Max Health is permanently reduced by 6% (+6.5% melee / +7.5% ranged per Fearless), and you gain 4% (+4% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed.
corrections.after: Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless (max 6). Max Health is reduced by 6% (+6.5% melee / +7.5% ranged per Fearless), and you gain 4% (+4% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless stacks are lost on death.

Aion.TransmutationDesc: Casting an Ability grants <ManaText>+{ManaRegen} Mana Regen</> for <ManaText>{Duration}s</> <EffectText>(Max {MaxStacks} Stacks)</>. Additionally, gain <GoldText>Gold</> equal to <AbilityPowerText>{DamageToGold}%</> of <AbilityPowerText>Ability Damage</> dealt to Enemy Heroes.
Aion.PhilosopherDesc: Every <EffectText>{Timer}s</>, gain <GoldText>{Gold} Gold</>. Interval is reduced by <EffectText>Ability Haste</>.
Aion.SacrificeDesc: Damaging an Enemy Hero with an Ability regenerates <ManaText>{ManaRegen}% Missing Mana</> over <ManaText>{Duration}s</>. On Hero Kill, regenerate <ManaText>{ManaRegenHero}% Missing Mana</> over <ManaText>{Duration}s</>.
Aion.BottomlessVialDesc: Killing a River Buff <EffectText>restores</> a <EffectText>Potion charge</> and <EffectText>permanently</> grants <AbilityPowerText>{MagicalPower} Magical Power</>.
Aion.ArcaneResonanceDesc: <EffectText>Basic Ability Cooldowns</> and <EffectText>Philosopher</> progress <EffectText>+{Progress}%</> faster per  <ManaText>{ManaRegen} Mana Regen</> (Max <EffectText>{MaxManaRegen}%</>).
Aion.PerfectionDesc: While above <HealthText>{Threshold}% Health</>, gain <EffectText>+{Haste} Ability Haste</>.
Aion.RunicFocusDesc: Gain <AbilityPowerText>+{AbilityPower}% Magical Power</> per <ManaText>{CurrentMana}% Current Mana</>.

Demiurge.AmalgamationDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{StatIncrease}% Item Stats</> (excluding Passives) and <EffectText>+{DamageIncrease}% Item Damage</>.
Demiurge.TriCoreDesc: Deal <EffectText>{OnHit}% Damage On-Hit</>, randomly chosen from <AttackDamageText>Physical</>, <AbilityPowerText>Magical</> and <EffectText>True Damage</>.
Demiurge.BloatwareDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{DamageIncrease}% Damage</> and <EffectText>+{DamageReduction}% Damage Reduction</> per <EffectText>Item</>.
Demiurge.BioMechanicalFusionDesc: Gain <AttackDamageText>{PhysicalPower} Physical Power</> per <AbilityPowerText>{MagicalPower} Magical Power</>.
Demiurge.CursedCorruptedDesc: Convert every <CritChanceText>{CritChanceConvert}% Critical Strike Chance</> into <EffectText>{AbilityHaste} Ability Haste</>.
Demiurge.MemoryLeakDesc: Ability casts grant <ManaText>+{ManaCost}%</> of their <ManaText>Mana</> or <GoldText>Energy</> <EffectText>Cost</> as <EffectText>permanent</> <ManaText>Max Mana</>. At <ManaText>+{ManaThreshold} Max Mana</>, gain <EffectText>+{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</>.
Demiurge.ConstructDesc: Gain <HealthText>+{Health} Health</> and <EffectText>+{Haste} Ability Haste</> per <EffectText>Level</>.

Exarch.SeraphimsBlessingDesc: <HealthText>Heals</> or <EffectText>Shields</> grant the Target (including self) <AttackDamageText>+{AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed</> and <AbilityPowerText>+{MagicOnHit}% Magic Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Exarch.IlluminationDesc: Gain <HealthText>Health Regen</> equal to your <ManaText>Bonus Mana Regen</>.
Exarch.RevelationDesc: Ability casts reduce <EffectText>Basic Ability Cooldowns</> by <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Exarch.FervourDesc: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes <HealthText>heal</> you and Allies within <EffectText>{Range} Units</> for <HealthText>{Heal}</> <EffectText>(+{Scaling} per level)</><AbilityPowerText>(+{MagicScaling}% Magical Power)</>.
Exarch.OmnipresentDesc: Gain <EffectText>{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</> when <EffectText>Out Of Combat</>.
Exarch.DelayedFateDesc: <EffectText>{DamageTaken}%</> of <EffectText>Ability Damage taken</> is dealt as a <EffectText>{Duration}s DoT</> instead.

Idrisil.CrystallineDesc: While above <HealthText>{Threshold}% Max Health</>, gain <EffectText>{ArmorIncrease}%</> increased <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>Magical Armor</>. <EffectText>Falling below</> <HealthText>{Threshold}% Health</> grants a <EffectText>{ShieldDuration}s Shield</> equal to <EffectText>{ArmorShield}%</> of your <EffectText>Total Armors</>. <EffectText>(CD: {Cooldown}-{CooldownLow}s)</>
Idrisil.ColdHeartedDesc: Receiving Basic Attack Damage from Enemy Heroes <EffectText>reduces</> their <EffectText>Movement Speed</> by <CC_Text>{Slow}%</> for <CC_Text>{Duration}s</> <EffectText>(Max {Stacks} Stacks)</>.
Idrisil.MendingDesc: After taking Hero Damage, <HealthText>restore {HealthRestore}/{Rank2}/{Rank3}/{Rank4}% Missing Health</> over <HealthText>{Duration}s</>.
Idrisil.IcyTouchDesc: Basic Attacks <EffectText>reduce</> Enemy Hero <AttackDamageText>Attack Speed</> by <AttackDamageText>{AttackSpeed}%</> for <AttackDamageText>{Duration}s</> <EffectText>(Max {Stacks} Stacks)</>.
Idrisil.GlacierDesc: Gain <AbilityPowerText>+{AbilityResist} Magical Armor</> per <GoldText>{Gold} Total Gold</> earned.
Idrisil.DiamondTipDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{PenIncrease}%</> <PenDamageText>Physical Penetration</> and <AbilityPowerText>Magical Penetration</> per <EffectText>Tier 3 Item</>.

Knell.PatinaDesc: Gain a <EffectText>{Shield} (+{ShieldPerLevel} per Level) Shield</> when not taking Damage for <EffectText>{Timer}s</>. Gain <EffectText>{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</> whilst the <EffectText>Shield</> holds.
Knell.PealDesc: Gain <EffectText>{UltimateHaste} Ultimate Ability Haste</>. Upon casting your Ultimate, Basic Attacks and Abilities apply the maximum amount of <AbilityName>Rust</> stacks for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. <EffectText>({CD}s CD)</>.
Knell.DampeningDesc: Incoming Damage from Enemies farther than <EffectText>{Units}u</> is reduced by <EffectText>{DR}%</>.
Knell.FractureDesc: Deal <EffectText>{Damage}% (+{DamagePerLevel}% per Level)</> more Damage against Enemies with the maximum amount of <AbilityName>Rust</> stacks.
Knell.ResonantRepairDesc: Whenever you are <CC_Text>Immobilized</>, gain <EffectText>+{Tenacity} Tenacity</> and <HealthText>restore {Heal}%</> of your <HealthText>Maximum Health</> over <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Knell.FrequencyDesc: Gain <AttackDamageText>{AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed</> and <EffectText>{AbilityHaste} Ability Haste</> per <AbilityName>Rust</> stack currently applied.
Knell.KnellDesc: Basic Attacks and Abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of <AbilityName>Rust</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. Each stack shreds <EffectText>{Shred}% (+{ShredPerLevel}% per Level)</> <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>Magical Armor</>, stacking up to <EffectText>{MaxStacks}</> times. You gain <EffectText>{ArmorGained}%</> of the <EffectText>Armors</> Shredded.

Krix.Bio-TitanDesc: Gain <HealthText>{Health}%</> <EffectText>(+{Scaling}% per Level)</> <HealthText>Max Health</> and <EffectText>Bonus Size</> equal to <EffectText>{Size}%</> of your <HealthText>Max Health</>.
Krix.FeastDesc: <HealthText>Heal {Heal}% Max Health</> and gain <GoldText>+{Gold} Gold</> on <EffectText>Unit</> kills.
Krix.RegenerativeTissueDesc: After not taking Hero Damage for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>, <HealthText>regenerate {Regen}/{Rank2}/{Rank3}/{Rank4}% Max Health</> <EffectText>per Second</>.
Krix.FesteringWoundsDesc: Your <EffectText>DoT abilities</> and <CC_Text>Immobilizing Effects</> reduce Enemy Heroes' <HealthText>Healing</> by <HealthText>{Antiheal}%</> for <HealthText>{Duration}s</>.
Krix.FeedingFrenzyDesc: Gain <AttackDamageText>+{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed</> per Enemy Hero within <EffectText>{Range} Units</>.
Krix.PredatorDesc: <AbilityName>Camp Leader</> Kills grant <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</> and  <EffectText>+{MS}% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{LeaderIncrease}s ({EpicMonsterIncrease}% Bonus Duration</> for <AbilityName>Epic Monsters</><EffectText>)</>.

Lotus.MetamorphosisDesc: Every <EffectText>{Time} Minutes</> and for each Takedown you achieve, randomly gain <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</>, <EffectText>+{Haste} Ability Haste</>, <EffectText>+{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</>, or <HealthText>+{MaxHealth}% Max Health</>.
Lotus.FlawlessDesc: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes <HealthText>heal</> you and Allies within <EffectText>{Range} Units</> for <HealthText>{AbilityPower}</> <AbilityPowerText>(+{AbilityPowerScaling}% Magical Power)</> <EffectText>(Once per cast)</>.
Lotus.MasterpieceDesc: Kills grant <EffectText>+{DamageBuff}% Damage</> and <EffectText>+{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Lotus.ImmaculateDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{DamageReduction}% Damage Reduction</> while above <HealthText>{HealthThreshold}% Health</>.
Lotus.PrimaDonnaDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{BonusDamage}% bonus Damage</> to Enemy Heroes, but take <EffectText>+{DamageTakenIncrease}% Damage</> from <EffectText>all sources</>.
Lotus.FragranceDesc: Deal <AbilityPowerText>+{MagicalDamage}% Magical Damage</> and <EffectText>+{TrueDamage}% True Damage</> to Enemy Heroes within <EffectText>{Range} Units</>.

Marrow.InsatiableDesc: <HealthText>Heal</> for <HealthText>6%/7%/8%/9%</> of damage dealt to <EffectText>Heroes</>, increased up to <HealthText>15%/20%/25%/30%</> based on your <HealthText>Missing Health</> (<EffectText>65% Effectiveness</> for <EffectText>AoE</> Attacks, <EffectText>15%</> against <EffectText>Monsters</>).
Marrow.TheMawDesc: <CritChanceText>Basic Attacks</> deal <EffectText>+{BonusDamage}% Bonus True Damage</> against Targets below <HealthText>{MaxHealth}% Max Health</>.
Marrow.BloodBankDesc: <EffectText>Store {HeroDamage}%</> of Hero Damage as <EffectText>Charges</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. Gain <AttackDamageText>+{Lifesteal}% Lifesteal</> per <EffectText>{Charges} Charges</>.
Marrow.TasteOfIronDesc: Dealing <EffectText>DoT Damage</> to Enemy Heroes grants <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Marrow.RosesDesc: Hero Kills increase <AbilityName>Marrow's</> <HealthText>Healing</> by <HealthText>{Healing}%</> for <HealthText>{Duration}s</>. Takedowns grant <GoldText>+{Gold} Bonus Gold</> per previous Takedown. (Max: <EffectText>{Stacks}</> Takedowns).
Marrow.JealousyDesc: While at or below <HealthText>{HealthHigh}%-{HealthLow}% Health</>, deal <EffectText>+{DamageLow}%-{DamageHigh}% Damage</>.
Marrow.HungerDesc: <EffectText>Steal</> <HealthText>{BaseHealthSteal}% Base Health Regen</> from Enemy Heroes within <EffectText>{Range} Units</>.

Nihil.EventHorizonDesc: Damage a Hero to gain <AbilityName>Doom</> for <EffectText>{StackDuration}s</>. <AbilityName>Doom</> grants <AttackDamageText>{AttackDamage} Physical Power</>, <AbilityPowerText>{AbilityPower} Magical Power</>, <ArmorText>{Armor} Physical Armor</> & <AbilityPowerText>{AbilityArmor} Magical Armor</> every <EffectText>{Interval}s</> <AbilityName>Doom</> persists. Stats gain <EffectText>{Scale}% more effectiveness per Level & Takedown</>.
Nihil.GrowingThreatDesc: At <EffectText>{Time} Minutes</>, gain <EffectText>+{DamageIncrease}% Damage</> and <EffectText>+{Omnivamp}% Omnivamp</>.
Nihil.FromTheAbyssDesc: <HealthText>Restore {Maxhealth}/{Stage2}/{Stage3}/{Stage4}% Max Health</> <EffectText>per Second</> while in <EffectText>Hero Combat</> or <EffectText>Out of Vision</>.
Nihil.ManaSiphonDesc: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes <EffectText>steal</> <ManaText>{ManaSteal} (+{MaxManaSteal}% Target's Max Mana)</>.
Nihil.AdaptivePlatingDesc: Taking <AttackDamageText>Physical Damage</> or <AbilityPowerText>Magical Damage</> grants <EffectText>+{BonusArmor}% Armor</> of that type <EffectText>(Max {Stacks} Stacks per type)</>. <EffectText>Stacks</> reset out of <EffectText>Hero Combat</>.
Nihil.InescapableDesc: Enemy Heroes within <EffectText>{Range} Units</> that <EffectText>Dash</>, <EffectText>Leap</>, or <EffectText>Blink</> are <CC_Text>Slowed by {Slow}%</> for <CC_Text>{Duration}s</>.
Nihil.TerrorDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{MinionReduction}% Damage Reduction</> vs. <AbilityName>Minions</> and <AbilityName>Monsters</>, and <EffectText>+{TowerReduction}%</> vs. <EffectText>Towers</>.

Pilow.ConvectionDesc: Gain <ArmorText>{Armor} Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>{MR} Magical Armor</> for every active stack of <AbilityName>Pilow</> on nearby Enemy Heroes.
Pilow.HarmonicCurrentsDesc: Casting an Ability restores <EffectText>{Restore}%</> of your <HealthText>Missing Health</> and <ManaText>Missing Mana</> over <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Pilow.LilSuckerDesc: Basic Attacks <EffectText>steal {MS}%</> of the Target's <EffectText>Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>, stacking up to <EffectText>{Stacks}</> times.
Pilow.BioluminescenceDesc: Enemies you damage take <EffectText>{Damage}% bonus Damage</> and are <EffectText>Revealed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Pilow.NeurotoxinDesc: <AbilityName>Pilow</> additionally increases <EffectText>Damage</> Enemies take by <EffectText>{Damage}%</> per stack.
Pilow.DiffusionDesc: Increases the Radius of <AbilityName>Pilow's</> <EffectText>Debuff Pulse</> by <EffectText>{Range}%</> and the <EffectText>Duration</> by <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
Pilow.PilowDesc: Decrease your <EffectText>Size</> by <EffectText>{Size}%</>. Upon casting an Ability, nearby Enemy Heroes within a <EffectText>{Radius}u</> radius are <CC_Text>Debuffed</>, causing them to deal <CC_Text>{DecreasedDamage}%</> less <CC_Text>Damage</> for <CC_Text>{Duration}s</>, stacking up to <CC_Text>{Stacks}</> times.

Satariel.BloodlustDesc: Deal <EffectText>{Damage}% (+{DamagePerLevel}% per Level) more Damage</> to the closest Enemy Hero but <EffectText>{LessDamage}% less Damage</> to any other Enemy Hero.
Satariel.BrokenWingsDesc: Your Movement Speed cannot be <EffectText>altered</> by Items or Abilities.
Satariel.HellfireStrikesDesc: Basic Attacks deal <EffectText>{Damage} (+{DamagePerLevel} per Level) True Damage On-Hit</>.
Satariel.RisenDesc: When at <EffectText>{Threshold}</> or more <AbilityName>Fearless</> stacks, gain <EffectText>{Omnivamp}% Omnivamp</>.
Satariel.RiteDesc: Abilities cost an additional <HealthText>{Health}</> <EffectText>(+{HealthPerLevel} per Level)</> <HealthText>Health</> to cast but you permanently gain <EffectText>{AbilityHaste} (+{HastePerLevel} per Level) Ability Haste</>.
Satariel.SatarielDesc: Takedowns grant a stack of <AbilityName>Fearless</>, up to <EffectText>{Stacks}</> times. Your <HealthText>Max Health</> is reduced by <HealthText>{Health}%</> (<HealthText>+{LossPerStack}% Melee</><EffectText>/</><RageText>+{LossPerStackRanged}% Ranged</> per <AbilityName>Fearless</>). Gain <EffectText>+{Gains}% (+{GainsPerFearless}%</> per <AbilityName>Fearless</>) <AttackDamageText>Physical Power</>, <AbilityPowerText>Magical Power</> and <AttackDamageText>Attack Speed</>. <AbilityName>Fearless</> stacks are lost on Death.

Thraex.ApexDesc: Basic Attacks <EffectText>Mark</> an Enemy Hero for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. You deal <EffectText>+{Damage}% (+{DamageScaling}% per level) Damage</> to them and take <EffectText>{DR}% (+{DRScaling}% per level) less Damage</> from them.
Thraex.AlphasCourtDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</> when no Allied Hero is within <EffectText>{Radius} Units</>.
Thraex.SavageStrikesDesc: Deal <AttackDamageText>{Damage} (+{DamageScaling} per Level) Physical Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>. Attacking an Enemy Hero <EffectText>increases</> this by <AttackDamageText>{Scaling}%</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s (Max {Stacks} Stacks)</>. <HealthText>Heals</> for the <AttackDamageText>Damage</> dealt.
Thraex.TheKingDesc: Basic Attacks on Enemy Heroes grant <GoldText>{Gold} Gold</>.
Thraex.FerocityDesc: Gain <AttackDamageText>+{AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed</> <EffectText>per Second</> in <EffectText>Hero Combat</>. <EffectText>Stacks infinitely</> and resets when <EffectText>Out of Combat</>.
Thraex.RallyingRoarDesc: Gain <EffectText>+{UltHaste} Ultimate Haste</>. Casting your <EffectText>Ultimate</> grants you and Allies within <EffectText>{Radius} Units +{Speed}% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. <EffectText>({CD}s CD)</>.

Vermis.WorldEaterDesc: Landing 3 Basic Attacks on an Enemy Hero within <EffectText>{StackDuration}s</> deals <HealthText>{Damage}%</> <EffectText>(+{Scaling}% per Level)</> <HealthText>Max Health</> as <AttackDamageText>Physical Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>.
Vermis.SerrationDesc: <EffectText>Vermis</> deals an additional <AttackDamageText>(+{Damage}% Target's Missing Health) Damage</>.
Vermis.CrushDesc: <CC_Text>Immobilizing</> an Enemy Hero deals <HealthText>{Damage}% Max Health</> as <AttackDamageText>Bonus Physical Damage</> (<EffectText>{Cooldown}s</> CD per Target).
Vermis.CauterizeDesc: When taking Damage from Ability or Passive Ability damage, gain <HealthText>{Healing}</> <EffectText>(+{Scaling} per Level)</> <HealthText>Health Regen</> for <HealthText>{Duration}s</>.
Vermis.MeltingPointDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</> to Targets with more than <ArmorText>{Armor} Physical Armor</>.
Vermis.BreachDesc: <EffectText>Ultimate</> Damage <EffectText>reduces</> an Enemy Hero's <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> by <ArmorText>{Shred}%</> for <ArmorText>{Duration}s</>.
Vermis.MechadriveDesc: Basic Attacks reduce your <EffectText>Secondary Ability’s Current Cooldown</> by <EffectText>{Cooldown}% On-Hit</>. Reduced to <EffectText>{NonHeroes}%</> against Non-Heroes.

Vesh.PrimordialMagicDesc: <EffectText>Ability Damage</> dealt to Enemy Heroes deals +<EffectText>{DamageIncrease}% (+{DamageScaling}% per Minute)</> of that Damage as a <EffectText>{Duration}s DoT</>.
Vesh.TitheOfDeathDesc: Takedowns restore <ManaText>{Mana}% Max Mana</> and permanently grant <EffectText>{AbilityHaste} Ability Haste</>. (Max: <EffectText>{Stacks} Ability Haste</>).
Vesh.TheTenthSealDesc: At <EffectText>Level {Level}</>, gain <EffectText>+{DamageIncrease}% Ultimate Damage</> and <EffectText>+{UltimateHaste} Ultimate Ability Haste</>.
Vesh.MindRotDesc: <EffectText>Vesh</> also deals <HealthText>{Damage}%</> of the <HealthText>Target's Current Health</> over the <EffectText>Duration</>.
Vesh.PhylacteryDesc: Casting your <EffectText>Ultimate</> grants a <ManaText>{ManaShield}% Max Mana</> <EffectText>Shield</> and <EffectText>{CDProg}% Cooldown Progression</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. <EffectText>({CD}s CD)</>.

Weald.ForageDesc: Gain <GoldText>{Gold}</> additional <GoldText>Gold</> and <EffectText>{XP}</> additional <EffectText>XP</> per <AbilityName>Minion</> or <AbilityName>Monster</> Kill.
Weald.Wind-RiderDesc: Gain <AttackDamageText>{AttackSpeed}% (+{Level}% per Level) Attack Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</> after using a <EffectText>Dash, Leap, Teleport</> or upon leaving <EffectText>Stealth</>.
Weald.DryadsBoonDesc: Basic Attacks decrease Basic Ability Cooldowns by <EffectText>{Decrease}s On-Hit</>.
Weald.TaprootDesc: Basic Attacks restore <HealthText>{Health}</> <AttackDamageText>(+{PPScaling}% Bonus Physical Power)</> <HealthText>Health</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>.
Weald.BarkskinDesc: Deal <AttackDamageText>{Damage}</> <EffectText>(+{DamagePerLevel} per Level)</> <AttackDamageText>Physical Damage</> to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This <AttackDamageText>Damage</> triggers <EffectText>On-Hit</> Effects at <EffectText>{OnHit}%</> effectiveness.
Weald.NaturalResistanceDesc: <EffectText>Cleanse</> all <CC_Text>Crowd Control</> and gain <EffectText>+{Tenacity} Tenacity</> when below <HealthText>{Health}% Maximum Health</>. (<EffectText>Cleanse: {Cooldown}s CD</>).
Weald.WealdDesc: Damaging an Enemy Hero below <HealthText>{Health}% Health</> fires <EffectText>{ProjectileCount} (+{ProjectileScaling}</> per <AttackDamageText>{AS}% Bonus Attack Speed</><EffectText>) Projectiles</>, each dealing <EffectText>{TrueDamage} (+{LevelScaling} per Level) True Damage</> and applying <EffectText>On-Hit</> effects at <EffectText>{Modifier}% Effectiveness</> (<EffectText>{Cooldown}s CD per Hero</>).

Xyris.TheDecreeDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{DamageBase}% Damage</>. Deal an additional <EffectText>+{DamageBuff}% Damage</> per <EffectText>{Units} Units</> killed, up to a limit of <EffectText>{Max}</> Units.
Xyris.FurorDesc: Entering <EffectText>Hero Combat</> grants <AttackDamageText>{AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed</> for <AttackDamageText>{Duration}s</>.
Xyris.IronWillDesc: <HealthText>Restore Health</> equal to <AttackDamageText>{BasicHeal}%</> of <AttackDamageText>Basic Attack Damage</> dealt. Increased to <CritChanceText>{CritHeal}%</> for <CritChanceText>Critical Strikes</>.
Xyris.CullTheWeakDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{DamageBuff}% Damage</> to <AbilityName>Minions</> and <AbilityName>Monsters</>. Restore <ManaText>{Mana}% Missing Mana</> on Unit kill.
Xyris.BoneCollectorDesc: Upon killing <EffectText>{Threshold}</> Units, permanently gain <CritChanceText>{Crit}% Critical Strike Chance</>.
Xyris.EviscerateDesc: Deal <EffectText>+{Damage}% Damage</> to Targets above <HealthText>{HealthThreshold}% Health</>.
